sub_sector.value: Respiratory royalties; critical care and anti-infectives; healthcare investments

healthcare_segment.detail: Manages respiratory royalties, develops and commercializes critical care and infectious disease therapies, and invests in healthcare assets.

product_stage.detail: Earns royalties on marketed respiratory products and commercializes specialty therapeutics, including ZEVTERA.

customer_payer.detail: GSK pays royalties on licensed respiratory products it co-developed with Innoviva.

therapeutic_area.detail: Respiratory products underpin the royalty portfolio, and the specialty therapeutics platform focuses on critical care and infectious disease.
